summary: "Rilla of Ingleside" by L. M. Montgomery is a novel published in 1921. The final book in the Anne of Green Gables series focuses on Anne's youngest daughter, Rilla, as World War I erupts. Nearly fifteen and carefree, Rilla must quickly mature when her brothers enlist and she unexpectedly becomes responsible for an orphaned baby.
